decisions.why: both products (AeroDR 3 1417SL, AeroDR 3 HL) are Konica Minolta AeroDR flat-panel digital radiography detectors, filed by the supplier under 'Detectors / Retrofits' - radiography/X-ray system hardware

the single product, Hologic 3DQuorum Imaging Technology powered by Genius AI, is a licensed imaging option that runs on Hologic 3D mammography systems and is only sold with them, so it belongs with mammography systems rather than with general imaging service
